description:
MEASURED, and the fix is one clause.

enum.fz:46  fn to_list(enumerable), do: reverse(reverse(enumerable))

Every builder is builder_list(to_list(enumerable), fun): map, filter, reject,
flat_map, map_reduce, scan, intersperse, with_index, map_every, map_join,
map_intersperse, sort, take*, drop*, split*. So the double-reverse tax is paid by
the whole building surface.

Measured N=20, input literal = 20 cells, TOTAL list_cons_allocs:
  op                        HEAD   with fix   floor
  Enum.to_list               60       20       20
  Enum.map                   80       40       40
  Enum.filter (keeps all)    60       20      <=40
  Enum.map |> Enum.filter   120       40       40
  hand-written recursion      -        -       40

The fix is fz's idiom for Elixir's 'when is_list(x)' -- a type-annotated clause head,
already used in kernel.fz for the arithmetic operators:

  fn to_list(list :: [a]), do: list
  fn to_list(enumerable), do: reverse(reverse(enumerable))

Outputs verified correct across to_list/map/filter/sort/take/with_index/reverse and
over both List and Range receivers.

KNOWN BLAST RADIUS -- adding a clause changes the dispatch population, so these six
move (verified: they pass at HEAD, fail with the patch):
  canon_test::backend_inventory_width_stays_pinned_on_the_target_fixtures
  drive_test::compiler2_dispatch_blind_escape_census_is_the_known_population
  transport_contract_test::positioned_callable_owners_have_observable_obligations
  work_start_reason_test::root_entries_and_caller_discovered_callees_share_the_activation_frontier
  public_trace_test::analysis_claims_survive_a_run_that_could_not_re_derive_them
  public_trace_test::target_fixture_reports_exercise_all_five_request_scenarios
Reductions re-bless. The blind-escape census needs adjudication, not blessing -- a NEW
escape would be a raise.

Also fix while here: reverse/2 calls to_list(tail) on an already-list argument
(enum.fz:52) -- two wasted traversals.

DONE = the table above, plus an allocation-golden fixture pinning the building
surface. behavior/enum_list_allocations.fz deliberately excludes map/filter/sort;
extend it or add a sibling so the builders are actually pinned.
title: Stop laundering Enum builders through to_list: add list fast paths
